_meta.comment: Flat format: each dotted key = one token, with 'value' (raw value) and 'comment' (usage). Units: colours as sRGB hex #RRGGBB; sizes in px on Windows (CSS) = sp on Android for fonts and dp for the rest. Explanations: design/tomi/brand-guidelines.md. Contrast values are recomputed by design/build/tomi-contrasts.mjs (exit code 1 if a pair fails).

color.identity.night.comment: Identity. 'Night': background of the app icon (tile, Android adaptive icon), background of brand media (store, splash screen), logotype on light backgrounds. Not an interface colour: in the app, use color.*.brand.

color.identity.sun.comment: Identity. 'Sun': reserved for the symbol placed on the night background (app icon, splash screen, colour logo). Never for text, a button, a state, or on a light background (contrast 1.5:1).

color.light.bg.comment: Light mode. Window and screen background (cream white, softer than pure white).

color.light.surface.comment: Light mode. Feed cards, tray popover, share bottom sheet, input fields.

color.light.surface-alt.comment: Light mode. Secondary areas: popover header, hovered or selected row, code block, revealed password.

color.light.text.comment: Light mode. Main text, titles, active icons (bluish ink, from the night family).

color.light.text-muted.comment: Light mode. Secondary text: source device, time, size, expired item, inactive icons.

color.light.border.comment: Light mode. Separators and card outlines, decorative only.

color.light.border-strong.comment: Light mode. Outline of fields, checkboxes, switches: interactive component, 3:1 minimum (WCAG 1.4.11).

color.light.brand.comment: Light mode. Interface 'night blue' (same hue as color.identity.night, brighter): primary Send button, links, unread dot, focus ring.

color.light.on-brand.comment: Light mode. Text and icons placed on color.light.brand.

color.light.brand-container.comment: Light mode. Brand-tinted background: active filter, selected chip. Text on it in brand or text.

color.light.secondary.comment: Light mode. 'Ochre': waiting states (offline, in the send queue, Cancel on the deferred-send banner), search highlight. Never for an error. More muted than the sun, which stays on the symbol.

color.light.secret.comment: Light mode. 'Plum': marker of hidden items (crossed-out eye icon, label, left edge of the card).

color.light.secret-container.comment: Light mode. Background of the hidden block of a hidden item ('•••••• Show') and of the Hidden chip.

color.light.success.comment: Light mode. Delivered status and the 'Sent' confirmation. Muted green.

color.light.error.comment: Light mode. Real errors only: failed send, unreadable item, confirmation of Delete everywhere.

color.dark.bg.comment: Dark mode. Window and screen background (very dark night, not pure black).

color.dark.surface.comment: Dark mode. Feed cards, tray popover, bottom sheet, input fields.

color.dark.surface-alt.comment: Dark mode. Secondary areas: popover header, hovered row, code block, revealed password.

color.dark.text.comment: Dark mode. Main text, titles, active icons.

color.dark.text-muted.comment: Dark mode. Secondary text: source device, time, size, expired item, inactive icons.

color.dark.border.comment: Dark mode. Separators and card outlines, decorative only.

color.dark.border-strong.comment: Dark mode. Outline of fields, checkboxes, switches: interactive component, 3:1 minimum (WCAG 1.4.11).

color.dark.brand.comment: Dark mode. Lightened night blue: primary button, links, unread dot, focus ring.

color.dark.on-brand.comment: Dark mode. Text and icons placed on color.dark.brand (dark text on light blue).

color.dark.brand-container.comment: Dark mode. Brand-tinted background: active filter, selected chip. Same value as color.identity.night.

color.dark.secondary.comment: Dark mode. Lightened ochre: offline, in the send queue, Cancel on the banner, highlight. More muted than the sun #FFC85C.

color.dark.secret.comment: Dark mode. Lightened plum: marker of hidden items.

color.dark.secret-container.comment: Dark mode. Background of the hidden block of a hidden item and of the Hidden chip.

color.dark.success.comment: Dark mode. Delivered status and the 'Sent' confirmation.

font.family.ui.comment: Interface font (SIL OFL 1.1, files in design/fonts/). Embed it in the app, no network loading. CSS stack: "Inter", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif. Android: res/font/. The 'tomi' wordmark is NOT set in Inter: it is drawn (logo-wordmark.svg).

font.family.mono.comment: Mono font (SIL OFL 1.1) for code, revealed passwords, URLs, file names, pairing codes. CSS stack: "JetBrains Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace.

font.feature.mono-password.comment: font-feature-settings for a revealed password: slashed zero.

font.feature.ui-digits.comment: Inter font-feature-settings for times, sizes, pairing codes: tabular figures.

font.weight.semibold.comment: Screen and section titles, device name. No 700+ in the interface.

font.size.title.comment: Screen and bottom-sheet title. Line height: font.line.title.

font.size.subtitle.comment: Section title, device name. Line height: font.line.subtitle.

font.size.body.comment: Card preview, item text, input field. Line height: font.line.body.

font.size.label.comment: Buttons, chips, filter tabs, menus. Line height: font.line.label.

font.size.caption.comment: Metadata (device, time, size, status). Minimum size. Line height: font.line.caption.

font.size.mono.comment: Mono content in a card. Line height: font.line.mono.

space.1.comment: Minimum gap: icon to label in a chip, metadata lines.

space.2.comment: Gap between elements of the same group.

space.3.comment: Vertical inner margin of a card, gap between cards.

space.4.comment: Horizontal inner margin of cards, the popover and the bottom sheet; Android screen margin.

space.6.comment: Large breathing space: empty screens, pairing screen.

radius.md.comment: Buttons, fields, feed cards, hidden block.

radius.lg.comment: Tray popover, bottom sheet, drop zone.

radius.full.comment: Unread dot, filter chips, device avatar.

border.width.secret-accent.comment: Left edge of a hidden item's card, in color.*.secret.

focus.ring.width.comment: Keyboard focus ring in color.*.brand, offset by 2 px.

icon.set.comment: Single icon set for Windows and Android (Apache 2.0). FILL 0, wght 400, GRAD 0, opsz = displayed size. No circular-arrow icon (sync, autorenew, refresh) next to the logo: see guidelines 6.3.

icon.size.md.comment: Type icon on a card, Windows popover buttons.

logo.min-size.symbol.comment: Minimum size of the symbol alone. Drawing per size: logo-16.svg (16 px), logo-20.svg (20 px), logo-24.svg (24 px), logo.svg (32 px and up). App icon: logo-app-16/20/24.svg, then logo-app.svg. See guidelines 2.4.

logo.min-height.lockup.comment: Minimum height of logo-horizontal.svg (whole bounding box); below that, the symbol alone. Wordmark alone: 12 px minimum x-height.

logo.clear-space.comment: Clear space around the symbol, as a fraction of its width: the bead diameter (64 units out of 208). Nothing inside this zone.

motion.duration.short.comment: Duration in ms: hidden-item mask, hover, switch.

motion.duration.medium.comment: Duration in ms: popover, bottom sheet, 'Sent · Undo' banner.

motion.logo.lap.comment: Duration in ms of the bead's lap (symbol animation), played once, with motion.logo.easing. Never looping as a loading indicator.

motion.logo.easing.comment: Easing of the bead's lap: soft start and end.

behavior.secret-clipboard-clear-ms.comment: Product reminder (docs/DEV.md, invariant 4): delay before the clipboard is cleared after copying a hidden item.

behavior.undo-window-ms.comment: Product reminder: duration of the 'Sent · Undo' banner.
